{{Quote|You of the future&hellip; ''hear me well''. The designs of the Dark Lords have come to pass. The ''two amulets'' are joined. The ''time is'' upon you.|Marka Ragnos, to Exar Kun and Ulic Qel-Droma|<ref name="DLOTS Audio">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
In [[3997 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a '''group''' of [[Force ghost/Legends|Sith spirits]]<ref name="DSS" /> of ancient [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]]<ref name="CSWE Sith amulet" /> led by [[Marka Ragnos]]<ref name="NEC" /> were summoned from the grave by [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] and [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] with the help of a pair of [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulets]] as part of an [[Dark Lord prophecy|ancient prophecy]].<ref name="DLOTS6">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 6|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 6]]</ref> Awakened once again, the spirits instructed them in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="CSWE Sith amulet" /> Ragnos' spirit crowned Exar Kun as the new Dark Lord of the Sith, his initiation into the dark side complete&mdash;with a single touch, Ragnos burned<ref name="DLOTS6" /> a [[Mark of Dark Lord of the Sith|mark of a Dark Lord]]<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> into the center of Kun's forehead,<ref name="DLOTS6" /> and Qel-Droma with [[Mark of Shadow Hand|that]] of a [[Shadow Hand]],<ref name="KOTORCG" /> whom Ragnos said would become Kun's first and foremost apprentice, all in an attempt to restore the lost [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] of a thousand years prior.<ref name="DLOTS6" /> The [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] devastated the galaxy once again, but the Sith Empire was not restored.<ref name="TSW">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War]]''</ref>

The [[Jedi historian]] [[Gnost-Dural]] mentioned the group centuries later when he researched Qel-Droma, Kun, and the Great Sith War as part of a [[Galactic Timeline (in-universe)|timeline]] of galactic history. He speculated that the fact that they supported Exar Kun suggested that they did not support the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]].<ref name="timeline10">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 10: The Exar Kun War|int=Timeline 10: The Exar Kun War}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith group, albeit unnamed, first appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 6|sixth issue]] of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Dark Lords of the Sith'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]], written by [[Tom Veitch]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]], penciled by [[Art Wetherell]],<ref name="DLOTS6" /> and published on [[March 14]], [[1995]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54576/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_dark_lords_of_the_sith_1994_6|text=Star Wars: Tales Of The Jedi - Dark Lords Of The Sith (1994) #6}} {{C|First printing}}</ref>

While ''Dark Lords of the Sith'' 6 established the image of the Dark Lords as a message carried through centuries from the time of the [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion]],<ref name="DLOTS6" /> multiple sources established that they were [[Force ghost/Legends|Sith spirits]].<ref name="DSS" /><ref name="CC">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]''</ref><ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref><ref name="KOTORCG" /><ref name="CSWE Sith amulet" /><ref name="CSWE Marka Ragnos">{{CSWECite|III|74|Ragnos, Marka}}</ref><ref name="CSWE Ulic Qel-Droma">{{CSWECite|III|55|Qel-Droma, Ulic}}</ref> This article assumes the latter sources are correct.

In ''Dark Lords of the Sith'' 6,<ref name="DLOTS6" /> the character who would later be identified as Marka Ragnos<ref name="NEC" /> is surrounded by ships flying as if in combat and says, "In my time, even as the Galactic Republic battles us to extinction." Furthermore, the comic's narration describes him as "the reigning Dark Lord of the Sith" during "a time when the Sith people were being driven to extinction by the Jedi Knights and the armies of the Galactic Republic."<ref name="DLOTS6" /> However, [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]] begins with Marka Ragnos having died before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] discover each other.<ref name="GAOTS2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]]</ref>
